scope: Local publication planning only; no repository created, no remote write, no login or credential changes.

proposed_repository.name: fallingwater-blender-reconstruction
proposed_repository.owner_provenance: Parent reports read-only GitHub connector get_profile confirmed this public login; this subtask did not query credentials.
proposed_repository.authorization: User explicitly requested creation of a public GitHub project and upload after completion. Completion gate still applies.
proposed_repository.gh_auth: Parent reports existing gh token invalid. No token inspected or modified here; connector binary-upload capability has not been verified.

github_limits.release_total_size_and_bandwidth: No aggregate size/bandwidth cap stated by official About releases documentation; avoid abusive backup use.
github_limits.lfs_default: NOT_SELECTED; no plan, quota, billing entitlement or paid spend assumed.

policy_sources.title: GitHub: About releases
policy_sources.observed: Up to 1000 assets, each under 2 GiB; no total release size or delivery bandwidth limit.

policy_sources.title: GitHub: About large files
policy_sources.observed: Git warns above 50 MiB and blocks above 100 MiB; browser limit 25 MiB; ideally keep repo below 1 GB.

policy_sources.title: GitHub: About Git LFS
policy_sources.observed: Plan-specific single-object size limits. LFS stores pointer files in Git; actual objects are separate.

policy_sources.title: Poly Haven: License
policy_sources.observed: Downloadable texture assets are CC0 and may be redistributed; website example renders, logos and text have separate terms.

policy_sources.title: LOC HABS rights advisory
policy_sources.observed: Current browser fetch returned HTTP 403. Prior local reference ledger preserves the government-created / copied-source distinction; no fresh item-level blanket release clearance claimed.

required_delivery.required: Editable final scene including architecture, site, furnishing, water, materials, lighting and named cameras
All actually used textures, authored rebuild assets, licenses, dependencies and verified water caches
Build, render, navigation, validation scripts plus data, seed, version and manifests
At least 12 visually accepted 3840x2160 Cycles showcase stills
At least 2 complementary accepted QA images for every one of 60 surveyed spaces (40 main / 20 guest, not 60 bedrooms)
1080p 24 or 30 fps 2-4 min main tour plus remaining-space clips and continuous water proof
Actually verified Blender 5.2.1 operation, camera/quality controls and water playback
Closed P0/P1 issues, dimension/photo/room/navigation/performance/portability evidence with explicit limits
required_delivery.channel: git; larger accepted evidence in release

required_delivery.required: Selected provenance-identified clean rollback checkpoints; retain all experiments locally

privacy_audit.scope_this_run: Only path mentions in explicit candidate scripts/top-level JSON were counted. No credential values searched or printed.
privacy_audit.findings: room_contact_sheets.py and tour-route.json currently include machine-specific path mentions; final .blend metadata, packed text blocks, image/cache/font/library paths and reports also require inspection in a public copy.
privacy_audit.release_rule: Do not publish this local inventory automatically; generate sanitized public release manifest containing only relative member paths, hashes, sizes, versions and evidence status.

packaging_algorithm.format: Independent ZIP archives, same common top-level Fallingwater/ directory, no overlapping member paths across packs; Python zipfile supports extraction without 7-Zip.
packaging_algorithm.order: model, rebuild assets/textures, final cache grouped by frame where possible, stills, room QA, films, selected rollback checkpoint
packaging_algorithm.large_single_file: If one accepted artifact exceeds budget, split its byte stream into 1000000000-byte .partNNN files with a join script and original SHA-256, then verify reassembled bytes before publication. Never strip cache channels or lower video quality to fit.
packaging_algorithm.verification: Hash source/member/archive, reject traversal and absolute paths, extract all packs into a new directory, reassemble any splits, verify exact selected file list, reopen Blender and render a representative frame plus beginning/end water frames. Only then create public repository/release.
